_how: Short announcements shown on the homepage and prayer times page while current. Each: kind (e.g. Eid, Ramadan, Notice), title, text, optional link and link_text, from and until as YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive, UK dates). Keep to three live at once. No phone numbers or bank details in text: link to the contact or donate page instead. Add banner (a short name, e.g. clocks-2026-10) for something nobody should miss: it then shows as a gold bar across the top of every page instead, until the visitor closes it, and stays closed on that device. Notices that share a banner name are closed together.

notices.title: The clocks go back an hour tonight.
notices.text: From tomorrow, Sunday 25 October, every salah begins about an hour earlier on the clock and the jama'at times move earlier too. Jumu'ah changes from Friday 30 October.

notices.title: The clocks went back an hour on Sunday.
notices.text: Every salah now begins about an hour earlier on the clock, and the jama'at times have moved earlier too. Jumu'ah changes from Friday 30 October.
